name: Robostream
source:
You feel sleepy… maybe you should have slept more…? Most importantly though.. is the robot streaming? With a hazy mind you go over to your desk to check. 

[From [url=https://biinxiix.itch.io/robostream]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你感到困了……也许你应该多睡一会儿……？但最重要的是……机器人正在直播吗？你带着迷迷糊糊的心情走到办公桌前查看。

[来自[url=https://biinxiix.itch.io/robostream]itch.io[/url]]
